item.title: Indian National Among Two Killed After Projectile Hits Residential Area in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Debris from an Iranian missile fell in a residential area east of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, killing two people, including an Indian, and injuring 12 others. Authorities are investigating the incident and assessing further safety measures.

item.title: What Did PM Modi, President Murmu and HM Shah Say About India’s T20 World Cup 2026 Victory?
item.description: India won the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, defeating New Zealand by 96 runs at Ahmedabad. Stellar batting performances, strong teamwork, and brilliant bowling secured a historic third title for India, earning widespread praise from national leaders.

item.title: March heat intensifies across North India; IMD warns of rising temperatures
item.description: everal parts of India are witnessing an early rise in temperatures as March begins, with some regions crossing 40°C. According to the India Meteorological Department, Pilani in Rajasthan recorded 40.2°C, while many northern and central states reported temperatures between 35°C and 40°C.

item.title: T20 World Cup prize money jumps 150% in 19 years; Know how much each team earned
item.description: ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 concluded with India defeating New Zealand in the final at Narendra Modi Stadium. The winning team received $3 million (around ₹27.5 crore) from the total $13.5 million prize pool announced by the International Cricket Council.

item.title: Iran fires missiles at Israel after new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei takes charge
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has taken charge as Iran’s new Supreme Leader following the death of his father Ali Khamenei. Soon after the announcement, Iran reportedly launched missiles toward Israel, escalating regional tensions.

item.title: Budget Session resumes today; S Jaishankar to address Parliament on West Asia crisis
item.description: India’s Parliament resumes the second phase of the Budget Session with S. Jaishankar set to address the Lok Sabha on the escalating West Asia crisis following the reported killing of Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Global Market Rout: Sensex plunges 1,900 points as geopolitical tensions rattle stocks
item.description: Indian equities signaled a sharp decline as the BSE Sensex fell nearly 1,900 points in the pre-opening session while the Nifty 50 slipped below 23,900. The drop comes amid escalating tensions in the Iran conflict and a surge in global oil prices above $105 per barrel.

item.title: Gold, Silver under pressure as global markets react to US-Iran conflict; Check prices here
item.description: Gold and silver prices declined in India as a strong US dollar and global uncertainty triggered selling pressure in the bullion market. MCX gold slipped below ₹1.61 lakh per 10 grams, while silver dropped over 1%.

item.title: Crude oil prices surge past $114 per barrel as Iran war disrupts global supply
item.description: Global crude oil prices surged past $114 per barrel as the intensifying Iran war disrupted production and shipping routes in West Asia. Brent and WTI crude recorded sharp weekly gains amid fears of supply shortages.

item.title: Parliament Budget Session: Uproar in Parliament as S Jaishankar speaks on Iran War
item.description: The Opposition is moving a no-trust motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. The Opposition had already filed a notice against the Om Birla in the first part of the Budget Session.
